mapper.select: SELECT 'CHALLENGE' AS type, challenge_code::text AS id, challenge_title AS title, '' AS subtitle, thumbnail_url AS thumbnail FROM challenge WHERE (challenge_title ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR challenge_content ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%') ORDER BY CASE challenge_status WHEN 'RECRUITING' THEN 1 WHEN 'ONGOING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, created_at DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT 'STORE' AS type, s.store_code::text AS id, s.store_name AS title, COALESCE(l.address, '') AS subtitle, NULL AS thumbnail FROM store s LEFT JOIN location l ON s.location_code = l.location_code WHERE s.store_status = 'APPROVE' AND (s.store_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR l.address ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%') ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT 'POST' AS type, post_code::text AS id, LEFT(post_content, 40) AS title, '' AS subtitle, thumbnail AS thumbnail FROM post WHERE post_status = 'ACTIVE' AND post_content ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY post_code DESC LIMIT #{size}
SELECT 'USER' AS type, u.user_code::text AS id, u.nickname AS title, '' AS subtitle, NULL AS thumbnail FROM users u WHERE u.nickname ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' ORDER BY u.nickname ASC LIMIT #{size}
